About.title: About Centro Torre Rosa
About.subtitle: Professional Profile
About.bio: Led by experts in child development, our center provides a safe and welcoming space for children and families. We believe in a holistic approach that respects each child's individual pace and potential.
About.schoolIntegration: We work closely with the Montessori school community, offering seamless support that bridges the gap between home, school, and therapy. Our assessments are tailored to support the Montessori educational philosophy.
About.philosophy: Help me to do it myself.
